items.title: 2- XX–XO System of Sex Determination (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 2- XX–XO System of Sex Determination: a main subheading of Systems of Sex Determination, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-104.

blocks.text: Jins tay karne ka yeh tareeqa kuch keeron (insects) mein milta hai. Misaal: tidde (grasshopper) ke 22 autosomes (11 jore) hain. Nar ke kul 23 chromosomes hain kyunke us ka sex chromosome 'jora' XO hai, yaani sirf aik X hai aur Y nahi. Nar do qisam ke sperm banata hai: aadhe mein X aur aadhe mein koi sex chromosome nahi. Jis gamete mein koi sex chromosome na ho use nullo gamete kehte hain.

Maada ke 24 chromosomes hain aur us ka sex chromosome jora XX hai. Sab eggs mein aik X hota hai. Agar X wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to XX maada bachcha banta hai; agar nullo sperm fertilize kare to XO nar bachcha banta hai.
